column1: # The Live Activity and Dynamic Island, iOS Design section 9. See shoot.sh for the columns.
# -demoScreen live is the DEBUG gallery in ios/Dawri/Debug/LiveGallery.swift: the Lock Screen,
# compact, minimal and expanded presentations of one state, drawn by the same TicketLive* views
# as the widget extension. The Lock Screen follows the theme; the Island shapes are always black
# with the dark values. Sample data only, so nothing moves under the shot.
# The real compact Dynamic Island: S10 on a frozen clock starts the T-014 activity, then the
# island flag puts Settings in front, so the app is in the background and the system draws its
# activity in the Island. The shot must show the number in the hue in the compact leading
# region. Light only, see the island flag in shoot.sh.
